title: Travel & instances
summary: City routes, rings, spires, waypoints and private dungeon runs.
body:
If a Classic destination fails to load

Close EverQuest and use launcher Play to install game update 2026101801 or newer. The patcher now checks and repairs terrain/object archives for 17 Classic travel destinations, including West Commonlands, Misty Thicket and Toxxulia. Confirm the launcher points to the folder you use. If your character is stuck, contact the owner for a location rescue; retain the exact error if updating does not resolve it. Native travel acceptance is still being checked.

Ten city routes with return books

Speak to Merrin in the tunnel for ten city destinations. Return books bring you back to the shared hub.

Druid Ring travel

Khalure offers the currently available Classic Druid Rings. Some routes and client installations still need checks. Report silent travel or missing-world failures to the owner.

Wizard Spire travel

Khaleid offers eight Classic Wizard Spire destinations from the tunnel travel area.

A Plane of Knowledge connection

A dedicated travel connection keeps the Plane of Knowledge reachable alongside the tunnel’s city routes.

Nightcap Recall

Make a hotkey for Ancient Attunement in the General abilities tab. It returns you to the tunnel with a five-second cast and ten-minute reuse, preserving your bind point and other home destinations.

Travel to places you have discovered

Find waypoint markers to unlock return destinations with the Waypoint Master. Discovering them all is a custom exploration quest.

Private dungeon runs

Instance Keepers offer Befallen, Unrest, High Keep, Najena, Cazic-Thule, Permafrost, and Nagafen’s Lair. Hail to choose Raid or Grind, enter, or join your group leader; use #instances for open runs and timers. Runs last 12 hours. Only the creator can confirm a reset, with no players, pending entries or recoverable corpses inside. Earned reward claims and permanent completion counts survive reset and expiry. The small floating-eye Keeper is separate from the waypoint portal.

Live testing: Raid and Grind dungeon modes are available from all seven entrance Keepers. Existing legacy runs keep their original behavior until expiry or reset. Gameplay and balance acceptance remain open.
